verdict.rationale: Orb documents creating subscriptions through a subscription creation API endpoint (orb-docs-8). It also documents editing a subscription's pricing, add-ons, seats, discounts and effective dates via the API (orb-docs-31). Supporting API infrastructure includes idempotency and SDKs in six languages (orb-docs-25, orb-docs-27), and plan changes with proration and preserved history are documented (orb-docs-16, orb-docs-32). Missing for 10: any evidence of pausing or cancelling subscriptions via API, explicit confirmation that plan changes are API-driven, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the lifecycle endpoints.
